note: The complete Dalaran Heist treasure / passive pool. kind passive = client tag DUNGEON_PASSIVE_BUFF (starts the game set aside, acts at its start: Generic.PlayDungeonPassives); treasure = a deck card. offeredAfterBosses per the wiki: passives after rounds 1 and 5, treasures after rounds 3 and 7, each offer three random options from the pool. No source names Normal/Heroic-only or class-only entries (Out of Games lists them all without restrictions), so modes is both. seenOfferedLiveAfter: the boss count after which our recorded runs offered it (loot-pools.json treasureOffers).

sources.quote: "selected from one of three random passive buffs from the pool of Passives" (after rounds 1 and 5); treasures "selected from one of three random cards from the pool of Treasure cards" (after rounds 3 and 7); both lists by card database id
